cards.explanation: The answer is Joshua son of Nun. He's standing right beside Moses, and back in Deuteronomy 31:23 the LORD commissioned him by name. Moses has the microphone today, and Joshua has the road ahead, friends.

The answer is so they can command their children to follow the law. Moses says, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law." Take it to heart FIRST, then pass it on. You can't hand over what you haven't taken in, friends. Moses has the next generation on his mind.

The answer is that they are Israel's life. Moses says, "…they are not idle words to you, because they are your life…" Not idle. Not decoration. Not a nice extra to hang on the wall. Their LIFE, friends.

The answer is True. Moses says, "…by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess." The land is across the river, and the words are tied to living long there, bakers.
The answer is Nebo. The LORD says to go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho. That's a very specific address, friends.

The answer is view. The LORD says, "…view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession." Moses is sent up there to look at it. It's a big view of a big gift, bakers.

The answer is that he will die and be gathered to his people. The LORD says, "…there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people…" It's a heavy part of the passage, friends, and I think it's worth moving through gently.
The answer is his brother Aaron. The LORD says Moses will die there "…just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people." Two brothers, two mountains, friends.

The answer is False. The LORD says, "…both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence." That means Moses and Aaron, together, at Meribah-kadesh. The LORD names the place, the two men and what happened, friends.

The answer is False. The LORD says, "Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it." Moses will see the land and the Israelites will receive it. It's a hard line, friends.
